name: peer_escalation
description: Wraps core/peer_cli.py's discovery/selection/preview and peer delegation logic (antigravity, qwen, claude) as CCOS capabilities.

capabilities.name: coding.peer_list_available
capabilities.description: Read-only: list peer CLIs (antigravity/qwen/claude) detected as installed on this device

capabilities.name: coding.peer_detect_task_type
capabilities.description: Read-only: classify a message/error log into the task type escalate() would use (debugging/refactor/generate/review/explain/complex/default)

capabilities.name: coding.peer_select_cli
capabilities.description: Read-only: which installed and enabled peer CLI would be picked for a given task type, without calling it

capabilities.name: coding.peer_build_prompt
capabilities.description: Read-only: preview the exact prompt text that would be sent to a peer CLI if escalation proceeded, without sending it

capabilities.name: coding.peer_delegate
capabilities.description: Delegate a task to a peer CLI (antigravity/qwen) with fallback handling for disabled peers

author: CCOS
